metrics.title: 1-1. Construction: pose, proportion, and the head
metrics.description: Head sphere, crosshairs, an S-curve for the center of gravity, joint marks, the peace-sign hand, and the perspective frame of the LGTM sign. This sets the balance of the figure.

metrics.title: 1-2. Rough lines for the character and the clothes
metrics.description: Over the construction lines: animal ears, the leaf, twin side locks, a loose red hoodie, a white dress with a balloon hem, knee socks, and boots.

metrics.phase_name: 2. Large areas of color, then light and shadow
metrics.title: 2-1. Flat color
metrics.description: The rough lines fade. Large local colors go in: coral-pink hair, light skin, a vermilion hoodie, a cream-white dress, a green leaf, and the LGTM sign.

metrics.phase_name: 2. Large areas of color, then light and shadow
metrics.title: 2-2. Light and shadow
metrics.description: From a key light at the upper left: shadow behind the head and at the neck, the bulk and shade of the hoodie, the round hem of the dress, and the volume of the legs.

metrics.title: 3-1. Hair structure, hoodie folds, and clothing shade
metrics.description: Overlapping bangs and side locks, deep folds in the sleeves, gathers and frills on the balloon skirt, and shade behind the knees of the socks.

metrics.title: 3-2. Eyes, expression, the LGTM sign, bells, and ribbons
metrics.description: Amber eyes with a gradient and highlights, a smile and a small fang, gold bells, red ribbons, white pompoms on the chest and shoes, and the letters and frame of the LGTM sign.

metrics.title: 3-3. Fine hair strands, frills, and midtones
metrics.description: Fine strands and trailing locks, soft midtones on the hoodie and dress, and volume in the frills and laces.

metrics.phase_name: 4. Review the whole picture, then finish
metrics.title: 4-1. Edges, small shadows, and corrections
metrics.description: A pass over the whole drawing: small gaps along edges, the second shadow and reflected light, fingertips, letter edges, and the contact shadow under the feet.

metrics.phase_name: 4. Review the whole picture, then finish
metrics.title: 4-2. Colored line art, eyelashes, iris, and letter edges
metrics.description: A fine iris and eyelashes, the fang, metallic shine on the bells, a sharp outline on the LGTM letters, and colored line art over the whole figure.

metrics.phase_name: 4. Review the whole picture, then finish
metrics.title: 4-3. Final highlights, hair shine, and small accents
metrics.description: Catchlights in the eyes, a shine on the hair, blush, sparkles around the LGTM sign, and tiny color corrections.
